summary.text: Julian Pierre-Griffin is the Democratic candidate for the Tennessee House of Representatives, District 65, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
According to Ballotpedia, he served in the U.S. Air Force from 1986 to 2006 and works as an entrepreneur.

paragraphs.text: Julian Pierre-Griffin earned a high school diploma from Whitney M. Young Magnet High School, an associate degree from Southern Illinois University and a bachelor's degree from the United States Air Force Academy.
He advanced from the Democratic primary for District 65 on August 6, 2026, with 100 percent of the vote in an uncontested primary.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Pierre-Griffin described himself as a graduate of the Air Force Academy, a retired Air Force Reserve officer, a Boys & Girls Club board member and a multiple small business owner who has lived and worked in the district for more than twenty years.

He listed his campaign messages as service to country, veterans' rights and Second Amendment advocacy, women's rights, infrastructure improvement and affordable housing, and named public education, public health, infrastructure and growth, and small business policy as his policy interests.
